page.title: Install blvm
page.lead: Pre-built binaries and Linux packages from GitHub Releases, with checksums.sha256 on every release. Verify before running.

packages.label: Linux x86_64
packages.description: 64-bit Linux binary (glibc). Default release features. No package manager and no service unit.
packages.verify:
# Run in the folder where you saved blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-linux-x86_64
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.9/SHA256SUMS
grep 'blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-linux-x86_64' SHA256SUMS | sha256sum --check

packages.label: ARM64 Linux
packages.description: 64-bit ARM Linux binary (Raspberry Pi 4/5 with 64-bit OS, Apple Silicon Linux VMs). The binary only.
packages.verify:
# Run in the folder where you saved blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-linux-aarch64
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.9/SHA256SUMS
grep 'blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-linux-aarch64' SHA256SUMS | sha256sum --check

packages.label: Windows
packages.description: Portable Windows 10 / 11 build (64-bit). The download is the binary. The WinSW sample is in the blvm repository under contrib/init/, not in this download.
packages.verify:
# PowerShell — same folder as blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-windows-x86_64.exe
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.9/SHA256SUMS' -OutFile checksums.sha256
$expected = ((Get-Content checksums.sha256 | Select-String -SimpleMatch 'blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-windows-x86_64.exe').Line -split '\s+')[0]
$actual = (Get-FileHash blvm-0.3.0-beta.9-windows-x86_64.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
if ($expected.ToUpper() -eq $actual) { 'Checksum OK' } else { throw 'Checksum MISMATCH' }

docker.title: Docker
docker.description: Image on GHCR for this tag. It runs as uid 61100 and stores data in /var/lib/blvm. RPC stays on loopback, so the command does not publish 8332. chown the host directory to 61100:61100 before the first start.
docker.runCmd:
mkdir -p blvm-data && sudo chown 61100:61100 blvm-data
docker run -d --name blvm --stop-timeout 240 \
  -p 8333:8333 \
  -v "$PWD/blvm-data:/var/lib/blvm" \
  ghcr.io/btcdecoded/blvm:0.3.0-beta.9 \
  --network mainnet --listen-addr 0.0.0.0:8333
